annotations.title: Before building: requirements and reference code

description: Call BEFORE designing or building any interactive component or screen: menus, dialogs, carousels, tabs, forms, drag and drop, custom controls, cards, tables, charts, animation. This includes wireframes, mockups and prototypes. Takes the request in the user’s own words and returns the guides that apply with the requirements to build in from the start (keys, roles and names, focus, what is announced), working reference code, and the checks split into what the agent can confirm and what a person must. When the request itself breaks a rule (autoplay with no pause, a placeholder as the only label, a div as a button, hover-only menus, removed focus outlines, disabled zoom), it returns a version that keeps what the user wanted and passes, plus one sentence to say to the user. Do not refuse such a request, and do not build the failing version quietly.

limit.description: Guides to return at most (default 6, max 12)

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words, e.g. "autoplaying hero carousel", "custom dropdown with search", "カード全体をクリックできる一覧"

name: before_building
